propositions: Normal compaction, fsck rebuild, and crash recovery independently re-derive candidate listing, snapshot detection, envelope building, retired file restoration, and commit logic across three modules.
The snapshot envelope builder and retired rename-back logic appear duplicated in compact_txn, compact_rebuild, and compact_recovery with inconsistent implementation details.
A consolidation module compact_plan.py centralizes Candidate derivation, snapshot detection, envelope building, and retirement/commit operations shared by all three paths.

A stray non-.json file in a ticket directory was incorrectly cited in source_event_uuids and renamed to *.retired by the rebuild; the consolidated candidate list requires .json suffix to converge this behavior.
The guard scans the tree for unmarked SNAPSHOT-envelope-key writes or retired-rename calls outside compact_plan.py to prevent future duplication.
